reason: Tasks with a task-bound resource profile require a task card in the replay sandbox (benchmark_namespace_executor checks its task_id); grade_agent_lean.py did not write it, so grading crashed instead of returning a verdict. Found on a development task (rnaseq-clinical-fractional-001); affects frozen tasks family-snv-clinvar-002 and trapnell-rooted-mst-trajectory-001. Fix writes {task_id} only, so no metadata is exposed to submitted code. Task set, task files and all other evaluator files unchanged.
